Frequently Asked Questions - Cab Service Bangalore

Got questions? We have answers regarding bookings, fares, and policies.

You can book a cab instantly through our online website booking form, by clicking the WhatsApp chat button for immediate assistance, or by calling our 24/7 customer helpline.
We accept multiple payment methods including UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit/debit cards, net banking, and cash payments directly to the driver upon trip completion.
Toll taxes, state permits, and parking charges are generally extra as per actuals unless specified otherwise in an all-inclusive package. Your driver will provide original receipts for tolls.
Yes! In fact, pre-booking airport cabs for early morning flights is highly recommended. Our driver details and vehicle number are shared in advance, and they will arrive 10-15 minutes prior to your scheduled time.
